audience: software teams who translate their projects in Weblate

useCases.title: Check how complete each language is
useCases.text: The AI reads translation statistics for a project, a component or one language, with strings translated, needing edit and percentages.

useCases.title: Find strings that still need translating
useCases.text: The AI searches strings with Weblate's query syntax, for example by state, and shows source, target, context and failing checks.

useCases.title: Review suggestions and accept good ones
useCases.text: The AI lists suggested translations waiting for review, newest first, and applies the ones you choose to their strings.

useCases.title: See who changed which translations
useCases.text: The AI reads the activity log for a project, component or language, with the user, action, time and changed text. It can filter by user or time range.

useCases.title: Translate a string, suggest a translation or comment
useCases.text: The AI sets the translation of one string, proposes a translation for review, or adds a comment to a string.

useCases.title: Fill missing translations automatically
useCases.text: The AI runs automatic translation from other components or from machine translation. In suggest mode it only adds suggestions for review.
